headline: Anthropic's Claude AI connects directly to your bank account for personalized financial advice
summary: Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers can now link accounts via Plaid for read-only access to transaction data, enabling expense tracking and bill analysis.
details: Anthropic has begun testing a new personal finance feature within Claude, allowing Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers in the US to connect their financial accounts.
The integration, powered by Plaid, provides read-only access to data from over 12,000 financial institutions, including major US banks.
Claude's Personal Finance feature cannot move, manage, or invest money, and is limited to accessing up to two years of transaction history.
Unlike some competitors, Anthropic emphasizes that this feature has no ads or sponsored recommendations and does not offer financial products.
Users can ask Claude to identify unexpected fees, track monthly bill increases, and generate spending charts and budget breakdowns.
Anthropic is exploring future collaborations with licensed financial professionals and regulated firms to expand its financial advice capabilities.
This move comes as Anthropic prepares for an impending IPO, expected within the next few weeks.
caption:

Unlike some competitors, Anthropic emphasizes that this feature has no ads or sponsored recommendations and does not offer financial products.

Users can ask Claude to identify unexpected fees, track monthly bill increases, and generate spending charts and budget breakdowns.

Anthropic is exploring future collaborations with licensed financial professionals and regulated firms to expand its financial advice capabilities.
